1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Alvesco, Brand Arnuity Ellipta, generic fluticasone furoate ellipta, Asmanex 
HFA/Twisthaler, Qvar Redihaler, Beclomethasone Dipropionate HFA

12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of asthma  
 
AND

UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines

2 - If the request is non-preferred*, history of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to a 
majority (not more than 3) of the following preferred inhaled corticosteroids:  
• 
Brand Arnuity Ellipta  
• 
Asmanex HFA/Twisthaler (mometasone)  
• 
Brand or generic Flovent Diskus (fluticasone)  
• 
Brand or generic Flovent HFA (fluticasone)  
• 
Pulmicort Flexhaler (budesonide)  
• 
budesonide respule (generic)  
• 
Qvar Redihaler (beclomethasone)  
 
AND 
 
3 - If the request is for generic fluticasone furoate ellipta, trial and failure or intolerance to 
Brand Arnuity Ellipta  
 
AND 
 
4 - If the request is for Beclomethasone Dipropionate HFA, trial and failure or intolerance to 
Qvar Redihaler
